modules.module_title: Coordinate with control room

pcs.pc_description: collate all information pertaining to the patient location, landmark, type & seriousness of emergency on receiving a call from the control room

intimate the control room post admitting the patient in the hospital/dropping him to specified location or in case of inability to reach the patient location in case of traffic jams or ambulance breakdowns

modules.module_title: Respond to emergency calls

pcs.pc_description: report to the designated ambulance parking location on time as per the schedule
identify the emergency codes used in the hospital for emergency situations
use appropriate language while speaking to the dispatch team to reflect professionalism
use communication equipment such as mobile phones, radio communication equipment, megaphones and other equipment as required by the (Emergency Medical Services) EMS provider
assist during evaluation of the situation of the patient(s) based on the call with the dispatch center
seek support when situations are beyond one’s competence and authority
perform Body Substance Isolation (BSI) procedure as per standards and requirements
prepare the ambulance with the required medical equipment, supplies, medications and other items as per the medical emergency

modules.module_title: Size up the scene

pcs.pc_description: check that all safety precautions are taken at the scene of the emergency
introduce oneself to patient(s) / attendant and seek confidence of casualty/attendant, as applicable
identify the implications of nuclear, radioactive, biological, chemical and explosive incidents and take precautions for self and others as per organizational policies
estimate the total number of patient(s) involved and call for backup, when required
explain the situation clearly to other emergency response agencies, when required and collaborate effectively
reassure the patient(s), relatives and bystanders who are in stressful situations by communicating effectively, and working in a confident and efficient manner
obtain information regarding the incident through accurate and complete scene assessment and document it accordingly
work to optimize and save time while avoiding mishandling of patient(s)
provide information and cooperate with law agencies in case of medico-legal emergencies

modules.module_title: Basic cardiopulmonary life support

pcs.pc_description: Perform Cardio-Pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) as per standard procedure
Demonstrate the technique of Operating the automated external defibrillator (AED).
Recognize the need to begin further BCPLS interventions (such as CPR) based on the patient’s condition

modules.module_title: Prehospital assessment of patients with medical emergencies

pcs.pc_description: maintain patient privacy
obtain informed consent of the patient for the assessment process, unless impossible because of their condition
position patient comfortably considering patient safety and avoiding further injury/damage
assess patient’s level of consciousness, responsiveness and altered sensorium including skin color and temperature
calm and reassure the patient
minimize any unnecessary discomfort and encourage the patient to participate as fully as possible in the process
record vital signs of patients
obtain the chief complaint of the patient and complete focused SAMPLE history in prescribed format
collect patient’s samples as per advice of healthcare provider
identify any life-threatening or high-risk conditions and alert the emergency centre/ healthcare provider immediately
provide accurate and clear information to healthcare provider
identify special medical/legal considerations to be followed in relation to medical emergencies
identify the symptoms and cause of visceral, parietal and referred abdominal pain and signs of hypoperfusion
provide the emergency medical care for the patient with an allergic reaction

modules.module_title: Emergency medical care to patients with Cardiovascular emergencies

pcs.pc_description: identify the symptoms of hypertensive emergency, angina, cardiac arrest and myocardial infarction
position the individual to perform Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) or chest compressions as applicable, wherever required as per standard procedure
monitor and evaluate the individual's respiratory function for the effectiveness of compressions and ventilation
cease the application of CPR when the individual regains airway and circulation
position the individual in an appropriate position to enable continued care according to condition

modules.module_title: Emergency medical care to patients with Cerebrovascular emergencies

pcs.pc_description: provide emergency medical care to a patient experiencing symptoms of a stroke
assess patient as per standardized pre- hospital stroke scale (such as the Cincinnati pre- hospital stroke scale)
determine the time of onset of symptoms

modules.module_title: Emergency medical care to patients with Respiratory emergencies

pcs.pc_description: identify the characteristics of normal breathing, abnormal breath sounds, irregular breathing patterns and the signs of abnormal breathing
evaluate the need for emergency medical care for the patient with respiratory distress & provide the emergency medical care accordingly
evaluate the need for nebulizer therapy in consultation with healthcare provider
perform abdominal thrust in case of choking

modules.module_title: Emergency medical care to patients with other medical emergencies

pcs.pc_description: check blood sugar using glucometer and assess clinical manifestations related to hypo or hyper glycaemia as per obtained readings
seek information from the patient about previous medications/treatment related to diabetes and record it
provide emergency medical care to the diabetic patient as per advice of healthcare provider
identify the characteristics of an individual's behavior which suggest that the patient is at risk for harming self or others
identify special medical/legal considerations for support during behavioral emergencies
use methods to calm behavioral emergency patients
Identify signs and symptoms of common medical emergencies which require first aid response
follow standard protocols while providing first aid care to victims for various medical emergencies
